item.title: Circa 1795! Wide floor boards! Over an acre in New Hampshire. $300,000
item.description: Those are some wide floor boards! The house was built in 1795. It is located on 1.4 acres in Alton, New Hampshire. Five bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,967 square feet. $300,000 Contact Tracy L. Hayes with Century 21: 603-332-9500 From the Zillow listing: Attention INVESTORS!! item.title: Rube Oldring House, Legendary Outfielder. C. 1890 in New Jersey. $285,000
item.description: Love the setting for this house! This was once owned by Ruben Henry (Rube) Oldring. He was a legendary outfielder for the Philadelphia Athletics. he played a pivotal role in the team’s victories in the 1911 and 1913 World Series. The house was built in 1890. It is located on .37 acre in Bridgeton, New Jersey. The house features a covered front porch, covered side porch, some wood floors, baseboards, spacious kitchen, exposed beams and a basement. item.title: The details! 9 beds/6 baths! Circa 1906 in Ohio. $235,000
item.description: This house has some amazing details! Love the fireplace with inglenook seating! The house was built in 1906. It is located on .34 acre in Toledo, Ohio. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, crown moulding, wide baseboards, stained glass windows, exposed beams, fireplace with inglenook seating, crown moulding, picture rails and vintage bathrooms. item.title: A lot of house for the money! Circa 1906 in Oklahoma. $499,000
item.description: This seems like a lot of house for the money! There is a pool and a large two story garage with guest area. The house was built in 1906. It is located on .71 acre in Chickasha, Oklahoma. The house features a large front porch, pretty staircase, wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards, updated kitchen, arched niche spaces and vintage tiled bathrooms. There is an in-ground pool, RV parking, carport and a two story garage. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 4,261 square feet. $499,000 Contact Shari

item.title: This is quite a house! Mid-Century Modern in Oregon. C. 1951. $5,195,000
item.description: This is quite a house! This mid-century modern house was designed by John Yeon. It is known as the Shaw House. Would be the perfect house for entertaining. The Shaw House was built in 1951. It is located on .61 acre in Lake Oswego, Oregon. The house features a wine cellar, media room, large patio, three outdoor fireplaces, pool, pool house and views of Mt. Hood.
